headline: Big30 Slams Request for Money & Chains Amid Federal Case with Pooh Shiesty
body: DJ Akademiks reports Big30 is furious after fans ask for money and chains while he battles a federal case with Pooh Shiesty. The post, shared on Instagram with 1,813 likes and 241 comments, highlights the rapper's frustration over financial demands during legal turmoil. Akademiks' post states: 'Big30 goes off on people for asking him for money & chains while he’s fighting a federal case with Pooh Shiesty.' The timing coincides with ongoing legal drama between Big30 and Pooh Shiesty, adding to the tension.
